skills.detail:
Creates a hologram at close range.
The hologram can be moved while the skill button is held down and will inflict Stagger and an ATK debuff to enemies at close range.
The hologram will disappear after it is touched by an enemy, after it receives any damage, after a certain amount of time passes, or when the skill button is released.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

When the enemy has an undefended Treasure Area:
Moves to the undefended enemy Treasure Area which is furthest from the user after the hologram disappears.
Also, nullifies Stagger for self.

When the enemy has no undefended Treasure Areas:
Increases own DEF after the hologram disappears.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
skills.name: Hologram

skills.detail:
Deals a close-range attack with an ATK debuff and a Knockback effect while the skill button is held down.
Also, HP will be recovered.
Reduces damage taken and reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.

The attack ends after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
You are able to move while holding down the skill button.

Afterwards, increases own SPD.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
